title: Oturum yonetimi ve guvenlik
purpose: Implements FR-E1-05: Session management -- logout clears tokens, 30-min inactivity triggers re-auth, expired/invalid tokens route to login.

loading.description: Spinner with message 'Oturum kontrol ediliyor...' while verifying session validity.

ready.description: Session timeout modal with timer icon, explanation, re-login and defer buttons.

empty.description: Message explaining no active session exists, with a direct link to the login screen.

error.description: Banner explaining session check failed, with reason and retry action.

offline.description: Cached session shown. If token expiry is imminent, a warning banner is displayed. Write actions disabled.
